notes: Disguise: on the Notes, Weather, Clock, Calendar and Flashlight screens you can now tap the title 5 times quickly to open the code box. Press-and-hold still works, but on phones it was easily cancelled by the slightest finger movement.
Disguise: if you forget the code, your app PIN now works as well as your passphrase.
Disguise settings and the privacy guide now explain how to open the real app.
